resources.string: Fawkes listens entirely on your phone, using an offline voice model. Download it once (~41 MB) and it never needs the internet again.

"FAWKES COMMANDS

Basics
- "flashlight on" / "flashlight off" / "torch on"
- "open YouTube" / "open it again"
- "what time is it" / "what is the date" / "battery level"
- "what is 45 times 12"
- "note buy milk" / "read my notes" / "clear notes"
- "volume up" / "volume down" / "mute" / "unmute"
- "brightness up" / "brightness down"
- "open Wi-Fi settings" / "open Bluetooth settings"

Calls and messages
- "call Maa" / "call him" (last person)
- "text Rahul on my way"
- "WhatsApp Rahul hi"

Alarms, timers and reminders
- "set alarm for 7 AM"
- "set a timer for 10 minutes"
- "remind me in 30 minutes to drink water"
- "remind me at 7 PM to call Maa"

Music and SOS
- "play" / "pause" / "next" / "previous"
- "SOS" (flashes SOS on the torch, 3 times) / "stop SOS"

Custom commands and routines
- "create custom command good night runs flashlight off and set alarm for 7 AM"
- "create routine good morning runs flashlight on then open YouTube"
- "when I say movie time runs volume down and brightness down"
- "list custom commands" / "list routines"
- "delete custom command good night"

On-device AI
- "ask what is the capital of France" (needs a Gemma model — see Settings)

Hindi (download the Hindi model in Settings)
- "टॉर्च चालू करो" / "टॉर्च बंद करो"
- "समय क्या है" / "बैटरी कितनी है"

Tips
- Say "Hey Fawkes" to wake it (turn on in Settings).
- Add the widget or Quick Settings tile for one-tap listening."
